name: embedded-agent-app-roadmap
title: Embedded Agent App Roadmap
description: Define an App-first embedded Agent client roadmap using Codex App Server sessions, CanISend MCP tools, a simplified Workbench, and an evidence-based Tauri-versus-Electron gate
creator: pengjiaxin
notes: Owner approved the direction and R0 on 2026-09-04; R0/R1 source and recorded local evidence are complete. Owner then requested removal of project Trellis skills and roadmap/process optimization. R2 now has R2a safety/consent and R2b durable history acceptance units in the existing plan; R2-R6 product implementation remains unstarted. No just-in-time child task or activation is required. Owner changed delivery priority on 2026-09-06: App-first execution is closed as superseded; R0/R1 source retained, partial R2 unaccepted, unfinished R2-R6 deferred. CLI-first work ordering is in the master roadmap. Merge target and protected integration remain pending.

meta.proposed_mvp: R0-R4: clean Workspace v4, one Codex App Server session, CanISend MCP review loop, simplified Workbench, exact managed-file history, and bounded recovery
meta.proposed_protocols: Codex App Server stdio JSON-RPC for MVP sessions; MCP for CanISend tools; generic ACP v1 stdio with Claude Agent first after MVP
meta.post_mvp_agent_channel: R10/R5 generic ACP v1 stdio channel, first qualified with Claude Agent; per-agent capability and provenance gates; no initial registry auto-install
meta.approved_ux: conversation-led Workbench with stages/readiness, evidence coverage, selectable Deliverables, scoped context consent, and contextual Inspector
meta.support_stack: Rust 1.97 + Tauri 2 + Svelte 5/TypeScript/Vite; Node and pnpm remain build-time only
meta.traceability: bounded session cache plus minimum durable origin bound to canonical product audit; exact file history and no private bodies
meta.git_boundary: Git tracks source, plans, tests, and release provenance; private Workspace content remains under the local revision/digest/audit authority
meta.file_versioning: logical output paths, actual generator/build identity, same-kind predecessors, current-head-only reuse, and exact Blob-backed repair/restore
meta.diff_engine: two-stage on-demand comparison in canisend-app using qualified similar 3.2.0 Myers hunks; no Workspace scan, Git runtime, temp files, or persisted patches
meta.verification_tier: focused invariant owners and one source gate per final integration head; protected CI, exact artifacts, and formal exact-build user evidence separate
meta.authority_state: App-first execution superseded by ADR-RN-0023; partial work is not accepted or qualified
meta.execution_control: direct execution using existing checklists; no mandatory Trellis task, activation, dispatch, or journal
meta.post_parity_cleanup: R6 after R4/parity/rollback window; independent of R5 provider expansion
